Type: carved two-door bar cabinet
Use: storing drinks and dining items; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, bohemian, rustic
Materials: solid mango wood, carved hexagon door relief, metal pulls
Colors: warm honey brown wood, silver
Shape: boxy cabinet, two doors with textured honeycomb pattern, slim top pulls, plinth with splayed tapered legs, compact
Feel: warm, textured, crafted
Goes with: white walls, rattan, green plants, brass; bohemian or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Wood Bar Cabinet, 18"W, Mango, French Honey Gray
product.description: Upgrade your home décor with this captivating industrial-style bar cabinet. The interior space includes wine-bottle storage on one side and shelves for glassware on the other, and the geometric pattern on the doors, sealed with French honey gray finish, adds interest to the piece. 18"W x 30"D x 35"H Modern styling that will blend well with most home décor Assemble in 15 minutes or less Care: Clean as required with a soft, damp cloth; wipe completely dry. Avoid placing furniture near heat vents or open windows. Long periods of heat or excessive dampness can cause splitting, warping, and swelling in solid wood. Protect fine furniture finishes from hot dishes, alcohol, and excessive moisture or dampness. Safety: Always use the anti-tip hardware when applicable and follow directions. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
